title: MigratorV2V3 has no self-pull forwarder: PhlimboV3-side unclaimable stable/promo banked to the migrator's own address is stranded, owner-recoverable only
description: PhlimboV3-side unclaimable stable/promo banked with MigratorV2V3 as beneficiary (unclaimable*Of[migrator]) is stranded from the migrator's perspective: MigratorV2V3 exposes no function that calls PhlimboV3.claimUnclaimableStable/Promo (no forwarder / self-pull). Value is NOT lost to the protocol -- the owner can sweep it out-of-band via emergencyTransfer.
impact: No asset theft and no permanent loss. Availability impact confined to one migrator identity's residual bank, fully owner-recoverable via emergencyTransfer. Does not reach Medium (protocol function not impacted).
attackPath: 1. Migrator processes a straggler pass and accrues pending stable/promo on the PhlimboV3 side, banked to unclaimable*Of[migrator].
2. The migrator's own address is blocklisted mid-pass (exotic precondition) so the direct transfer path fails and value falls into the PhlimboV3-side unclaimable bank.
3. MigratorV2V3 has no function that pulls that bank -> value is unreachable via the migrator.
likelihood: very low -- requires the migrator's own address to be blocklisted at the exact moment it holds accrued pending; recoverable by owner.
severityRationale: Low/informational. No theft, no permanent loss; trigger is an exotic precondition (self-blocklist mid-pass with accrued pending); recoverable by owner. Kept in scope (recall beats report-tidiness) as a design/operational footgun. Distinct from V3-L-08, V3-F-01, V3-Q-01 (different banks/root-causes).
recommendation: Add a forwarder on MigratorV2V3 that calls PhlimboV3.claimUnclaimableStable/Promo for itself, so the migrator can recover its own PhlimboV3-side bank without owner intervention.
